topic: Template Class with Default Parameters and Range Constructor
explanation: In modern C++, template classes can be designed with default template parameters to provide flexible and customizable behavior. Additionally, range-based constructors enable efficient initialization of container-like classes (such as std::multimap) from a pair of iterators, facilitating seamless integration with the Standard Template Library (STL) algorithms and other containers. This combination allows for generic, efficient, and expressive code that adapts to various data sources and comparison strategies.
